featured_reviews.name: Frenney Lobo
featured_reviews.review_text:
BEWARE SCAMMERS - everyone is a FRAUD including staff and shop manager

I went to purchase locks and 50+ handles on 14/09/2025 on the recommendation of my carpenter. I was looking for brass handles and the sales person confidently showed me rose coloured handles no. 5043 Decorita brand saying they are made of brass. I even paid 10k deposit as I was happy with the options they had and my selection which was shortlived.

Thankfully I went to another shop the following day in the suburbs and I was made aware by an honest shopkeeper that the handles I selected are made of "steel" and that's when I realised I was cheated. This shopkeeper even showed me the catalogue and showed me that the handle no. 5043 Decorita brand was indeed steel.

I confronted Chandni hardware sales person on 18/09/2025 to show me the catalogue for the handle no. 5043 but he denied having a catalogue for the same saying they don't get catalogues for all brands and kept insisting the handle is made of brass and I had to believe him that's it and that there was no other way to prove the material is brass. This is against Consumer Protection Act of 2019 violating the Right to be informed. The shop owner /Manager and sales person also started arguing with me probably thinking I am a lady and I won't be able to catch their bull shit. I showed them the proof of the catalogue picture. I told them as a customer it is my right to know the printed price and the material used in printed form.

Finally since I had paid the 10k, I was forced to take some of the items which when I cross checked the price with another shop, are actually highly priced. So overall I was cheated by these sweet talking shop people who are not trustworthy but kept insisting that I trust them. Such kind of people spoil the name of the entire community.

I am going to add reviews about Chandni Hardware on all other social media pages to warn other gullible customers to not be cheated in the name of "trusting them" as well as file a complaint with the Consumer Redressal forum for such fraudulent activities.

featured_reviews.name: Khyati Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
When it comes to any of the hardware solutions, we have always preferred Jyoti Hardware Stores.
A very modest store which hosts a variety of products. Most of the products are reasonably charged.
Took door knobs and handles from the store. By far they serve our purpose and are very sturdy.

Its a one stop shop for anything to do with your hardware/interior products. When you have any renovation/repairing  work in your house or office spaces, theres a lot to be looked after. The best thing i found was the way they would give you good leads for other products as well.
The staff is co-operative and will always facilitate your needs.

featured_reviews.name: Geeta V
featured_reviews.review_text:
Rude owner.  Recently purchased a clothes hanger from them   They don’t even provide carpentry services considering the installation is not easy
Prices were way above those available for same brand online.   The. Buffers given for Rods break often or rods almost every other time I dry clothes the rods fall down or me. The vendor refused to even listen. He asks me to pay extra for buffer. It’s better to purchase from Amazon or online  rather than these stores

featured_reviews.name: Namrata Chhadva
featured_reviews.review_text:
If one is looking for a one stop store for hardware products, they must definitely go to Jyoti Hardware Store at dadar west as they have huge range of products readily available at best market prices! They are best known for their honesty and fair business policies and I am extremely happy to shop from there!
They are very helpful with the products and also suggest those that they don't sell by giving useful references as to where to source those products from.

I also bought cloth drying stands from there...they have huge range of stands and ladders also.

featured_reviews.name: Rushabh Savla
featured_reviews.review_text: I was in search of a good hardware store which could be a one stop go for all the hardware products which would be required for renovation of my house..and luckily i found Jyoti Hardware Store which is in the heart of Dadar west and easily accessible by all means of transport..all my needs from the smallest requirements like nuts and bolts to the largest like ladders, aluminium fittings…the staff was very co-operative and easy to go to…the owner himself was keeping a watch that all the customers should be satisfied and should go with home with what they were looking for and with the best of quality…and for last the price offered was so reasonable that helped me to not shell any extra amount above my budget..and prompt delivery timeline for sending all the products at your door step….i would definitely give them a high five star rating and recommended to my friends and family as welll. Jyoti Hardware Store is a must go…..

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Niser
featured_reviews.review_text:
It’s a shop where u get all kind hardware fitting n fixtures at reasonably rate .It has huge variety of handle, door lock  Aluminium ladder , Cloth Drying Stands  mosquito 🦟 net Birds net  Etc

The staff is very much co-operative quite helping and and will always facilitate your needs. the owner is quite humble person.

featured_reviews.name: Niraj Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Recently there was carpentry work going on at our place and the first day when my carpenter gave me the list of hardware required, I was taken aback looking at his handwriting and the way things were scribbled. I sent it to mr pratik gada of jyoti hardware and he could decode it within minutes. After that day our carpenter would directly send his list and Mr Pratik would always respond promptly to him. He was very helpful, quick with his correspondence, clear with his accounts and super fast service.

featured_reviews.name: shubham udani
featured_reviews.review_text: The shop management is really good in terms of service, the variety of products at budget friendly rates is something one will really expect when making a house , Jyoti Hardware is one of those shops which has really supported us when our house was being made
